PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Reports Steady Trade Activity in UAE Oil & Gas Services Sector

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, a prominent player in the Oil & Gas Services & Equip sector, reported steady trade activity in the United Arab Emirates for the first quarter of 2024. According to figures released Tuesday, the company maintained a consistent volume of equipment deliveries and technical service contracts, reflecting ongoing stability across its UAE operations.

Quarterly data showed that overall service orders remained in line with previous expectations, with a minor uptick in offshore support vessel deployments. "Our team has continued to meet the needs of clients in the region, with particular strength in maintenance and inspection services," said Nguyen Van Hai, Regional Director for PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp in the Middle East. "We are encouraged by the sustained demand and look forward to building on these results in the coming months."

Industry analysts noted that the company's performance mirrors the broader resilience in the UAE's oil and gas services market. "Routine trade flows remain healthy, supported by consistent project activity across Abu Dhabi and other emirates," said Fatima Al Mansoori, an energy market analyst at Gulf Research Solutions. "PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp’s stable results reinforce the positive momentum we’re seeing in the sector."

Trade bodies such as the UAE Oilfield Services Association echoed this sentiment, pointing to continued investment in infrastructure and field maintenance. The association's latest report indicated a modest 3% rise in sector-wide contract volumes compared to the same period last year. No significant disruptions or supply chain issues were reported for the period.
